text.title: Remote 1:1 Async Fallback Decision Tree
text.summary: Tree mapping sync feasibility, leave status and observed response state (in window, late, missing) to post / pause / ack / reschedule / escalate.

decision-tree.root-question: Is a synchronous 1:1 feasible this cycle, or has the pair already run 3 async cycles in a row?

conclusion.verdict: hold the synchronous 1:1; async is fallback only
do not post another note; book a synchronous call (rotate the off-hours burden) before the next cycle

branch.when: sync_feasible == false AND IC on formal leave (vacation / parental / sick) during the cycle

conclusion.verdict: mark the cycle paused; no note, no reminders, count unchanged

branch.when: sync_feasible == false AND IC not on leave AND consecutive_async_cycles < 3
branch.question: Did the IC answer all three prompts with received_at inside the window counted in the IC's business hours?

branch.when: prompts generic OR any prompt under 10 chars OR morale not on workload/autonomy/clarity scales

conclusion.verdict: fix the prompts before posting; a vague prompt cannot produce a valid cycle

branch.when: response_window_business_hours outside 24-168 OR window counted in PM timezone

conclusion.verdict: repair the window (24-168, IC's working days) and recount before judging the response late

branch.when: all three fields present inside window (empty answers allowed)

conclusion.verdict: ack within 24 business hours; one owned, sprint-dated action per reported blocker or decision; count resets to 0

branch.when: a field is missing OR the reply exists only in another channel

conclusion.verdict: treat as unresponsive; do not transcribe on the IC's behalf; ask the IC to complete the note

branch.when: window expired AND unresponsive_count after this cycle == 1

conclusion.verdict: action = synchronous_reschedule; offer a sync slot within the next cycle

branch.when: window expired AND unresponsive_count after this cycle >= 2

conclusion.verdict: action = escalate_to_manager with count and last acked actions only; no further async note until synchronous contact

branch.when: quarterly review due OR last_reviewed older than 90 days

conclusion.verdict: compute in-window response rate; below 80% over 4 cycles forces a window change, pair restructure or sync mandate

text.example: sync_feasible=false (no overlapping hours), 1 async cycle so far, IC not on leave → all three fields received 31 business hours after posting (IC's clock) → PM acks same day with one action (owner PM, deadline S14) → count 0.
